title: On the White-Noise Limit of the Colored Linear Inverse Model
summary: A recent paper by Lien et al. (2025) introduces the "colored linear inverse model" (colored LIM), in which stochastic forcing is modeled using Ornstein-Uhlenbeck colored noise rather than idealized white noise. In that work, it is shown that the derivative-based identification formulas used to estimate model parameters do not admit a regular white-noise limit due to the loss of differentiability of the lag-correlation function at zero lag.
